description: Self-hosted, open-source MCP gateway with SSO, per-tool access control, human approvals and a tamper-evident audit log

Falcosidekick: forwards Falco alerts to chat, logs, SIEM, cloud and webhook outputs (60+), with Prometheus metrics. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
